meta.title: Adrenocortical carcinoma & malignant pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma in silico decision trainer
meta.condition: Adrenal malignancies: adrenocortical carcinoma (ACC) and malignant pheochromocytoma/paraganglioma (PPGL)
meta.population: Adults (and the pediatric R337H reality) with adrenal malignancies - THE HORMONE-FIRST GLAND: two diseases whose first decisions are biochemical. ACC (0.7-2 per million/yr; bimodal - the childhood peak carries southern Brazil's TP53 R337H founder story, VERIFIED: the variant in 95% of young-childhood adrenocortical tumors, pediatric incidence 10-15 per million there; the adult peak in the fourth-to-fifth decades; ~60% functional, verified - cortisol and androgens) and MALIGNANT PPGL (the rule of 10 is DEAD - the NEJM 'Death of an Axiom' receipt cited by name; 30-40% germline, verified verbatim, which is why EVERY PPGL patient gets genetic testing; SDHB the malignancy driver - 23% vs 3% malignancy in SDHB-vs-SDHD carriers, verified). THE CENSUS HEADLINE (corrections 52nd/53rd): BELZUTIFAN was FDA-approved for advanced PPGL on 2025-05-14 (LITESPARK-015 A1: ORR 26%, median DOR 20.4 months, NEJM 2025 - the first ORAL therapy ever approved for PPGL) while AZEDRA - approved 2018 - was COMMERCIALLY DISCONTINUED (~2024, no doses after 2024-03): belzutifan is now the ONLY on-label US systemic PPGL therapy, and any 'Azedra is the approved option' teaching is doubly obsolete.
meta.summary: Evidence-linked teaching application for the hormone-first gland, completing the registry's authoring queue. THE BORDERS: the benign incidentaloma is a BOUNDARY, not a patient (ESE 2023 verified: <=10 HU homogeneous = benign, no further imaging regardless of size - the restraint rule); adrenal METASTASES belong to their primary's trainer (the registry-index reroute - the twenty-first, echoing cup's). THE ACC CHAPTERS: open adrenalectomy for suspected ACC (guideline-verified standard - with the honest nuance: laparoscopy is not flatly contraindicated below 6cm with experience; spillage is the…
meta.disclaimer: Synthetic teaching environment. Not medical advice; every number is a claim with a citation and an expiry date.
meta.classification: ACC (ENSAT staging; S-GRAS supplanting pure stage for prognosis - noted) vs malignant PPGL (WHO: all PPGL have metastatic potential); the ESE 2023 incidentaloma framework (verified: homogeneous <=10 HU lesions are benign regardless of size - and washout is DE-EMPHASIZED in the 2023 update); profile router = resectable ACC / advanced ACC / metastatic PPGL
meta.response: Imaging response conventions; hormone control as its own endpoint in both diseases (cortisol in functional ACC; catecholamines in PPGL - where the approved drug's co-endpoint was antihypertensive reduction, the endpoint-tailored-to-biology motif)

refs.label: EPI, verified: ACC 0.7-2 per million/yr (mirror); bimodal - childhood peak + adult fourth-to-fifth decades (verbatim snippet); ~60% functional (verbatim: 'more than 60%... most commonly producing excess cortisol and androgens'); THE R337H STORY verified (PMID 15761534, pubmed-url-match: the founder variant in 95% of young-childhood adrenocortical tumors; southern-Brazil pediatric incidence 10-15/million; carrier rate 0.3%). PPGL rarer still; the rule of 10 DEAD by NEJM title ('Pheochromocytoma - Death of an Axiom') | PMID 15761534 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE RESTRAINT RULE, verified: ESE/ENSAT 2023 incidentaloma guideline (PMID 37318239, pubmed-url-match): 'homogeneous lesions with HU <=10 on unenhanced CT are benign and do not require any additional imaging independent of size' (verbatim); HU 11-20 + <4cm -> immediate additional imaging; metanephrines NOT mandatory for <=10 HU lesions (the 2023 change); WASHOUT DE-EMPHASIZED (pre-2023 sources contradict - the trap). Prevalence ~3-5% of abdominal CTs, to ~7% elderly (sourced phrasing) | PMID 37318239 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

ACC SURGERY, verified: 'Open surgery is the standard surgical approach for confirmed or highly suspected ACC' (ESE/ENSAT 2018 + ESES/ENSAT PMID 28199015, matched) - WITH the honest nuance: laparoscopy NOT flatly contraindicated (<6cm, no invasion, experienced surgeon - retrospective/meta-analytic, 'controversial'); SPILLAGE the catastrophe (verbatim: 'tumor capsule violation, tumor fragmentation, port-site or peritoneal carcinomatosis'); R0/en-bloc = guideline-grade convention | PMID 28199015 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE MITOTANE SIGNATURE at exact grade: ADIUVO (Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinol 2023 - PMID 37619579, pubmed-url-match - NOT NEJM, correction 54th): adjuvant mitotane vs surveillance in R0/stage I-III/Ki67<=10% ACC - 5-yr RFS 79% vs 75% (HR 0.74 [0.30-1.85]); OS NS; 100% AEs, 19% discontinued; 'do not support routine use of adjuvant mitotane in this subset' (VERBATIM) - underpowered because prognosis beat the design (the honest wrinkle; never spun either direction). HIGH-RISK: Terzolo 2007 (PMID 17554118, matched - NEJM but RETROSPECTIVE: the journal-is-not-design trap). TDM window 14-20 mg/L verified ('correlated with a higher response rate'; >20 = neurotoxicity without gain). FDA-approved 1970 (correction 56th - first clinical use ~1959-60; never 'approved in the 1960s'). Ki67<=10% = the operational adjuvant threshold; ADIUVO-2 (NCT03583710) EU-active, US status CONFLICTING - never asserted | PMID 37619579 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: Lancet D&E + NEJM-retrospective + TDM literature (matched; corrections logged)

refs.label: FIRM-ACT, verified (PMID 22551107, pubmed-url-match: 'Combination Chemotherapy in Advanced Adrenocortical Carcinoma,' NEJM 2012): EDP-M vs streptozocin-mitotane - PFS 5.0 vs 2.1 months; OS 14.8 vs 12.0 NOT significant (all verbatim); EDP-M ORR 23% vs 9.2%. THE TRAP (correction 57th): the 53%/36% figures circulating are the trial's INTRO-cited legacy single-arm numbers - never the trial's results. NO randomized successor exists (the first-line desert) | PMID 22551107 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

IO IN ACC - two trials, never blended: Raj (JCO 2020 - PMID 31644329, pubmed-url-match): pembrolizumab n=39, ORR 23% (11-39), DCR 52% - MSK; Habra (JITC 2019): ORR 14% (2/14) - MD ANDERSON (the sources swap the institutions - trap). DART nivo+ipi ACC cohort (2024): ORR 14% (3/21); CA209-538 ORR 33% but n=6; rare-GU cohort 6% - weak-to-modest, no registration path. EO2401 vaccine (SPENCER): ORR 12%, mPFS 1.9 - census read: insufficient | PMID 31644329 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: JCO + JITC + SWOG (matched; conflation trap documented)

refs.label: THE TWO PPGL DISCIPLINES: METANEPHRINES-FIRST (Lenders JAMA 2002 - plasma free metanephrines 99% sensitivity, snippet-verified; biochemistry before imaging, before needles - the unblocked-pheo biopsy is the classic catastrophe); ALPHA-BLOCKADE-FIRST (Endocrine Society 2014 CPG, Lenders JCEM - 7-14 days + salt/volume; phenoxybenzamine PREFERRED, doxazosin 'may be equally effective' - so 'alpha-blockade first,' never 'phenoxybenzamine mandated'; the guideline formally RETIRED 2022 - cited with that caveat, paired with 2021 NANETS + 2023 ESE). Rule of 10 DEAD (NEJM 'Death of an Axiom')

THE REWRITTEN PPGL CARD (corrections 52nd/53rd/55th): BELZUTIFAN - FDA 2025-05-14, adults + peds >=12, advanced PPGL (LITESPARK-015 A1, n=72: ORR 26% [17-38], median DOR 20.4 mo, 32% halved >=1 antihypertensive >=6 mo - the biology-tailored endpoint; NEJM 2025 NEJMoa2504964) - the FIRST oral PPGL approval and, with AZEDRA DISCONTINUED (approved 2018-07-30 on the antihypertensive-endpoint single-arm; discontinuation announced 2023-08, no doses after 2024-03 - commercial, not safety), the ONLY on-label US systemic option. SUNITINIB - FIRSTMAPPP (Lancet 2024 - PMID 38402886, matched): the FIRST randomized trial in metastatic PPGL, randomized double-blind placebo-controlled PHASE 2 (n=78): 12-mo PFS 36% (14 of 39, 90% CI 23-50) vs 19% (7 of 39, 90% CI 11-31) - note the trial reports 90% confidence intervals, not 95%; grade 3-4 asthenia 18% vs 3%, hypertension 13% vs 10%. Figures re-read firsthand 2026-09-10; the previously displayed '35.9% vs 18.9%' appears nowhere in the publication and 18.9% does not reconcile with 7 of 39. Phase 2, never phase 3 (correction 55th). CVD retrospective (Averbuch 3395037; Huang 18780317; meta 25041164: tumor PR ~37%, biochemical ~40% - all matched). 177Lu-DOTATATE NIH ph2 interim (JCO 2025): PFS 24.6 sporadic / 13.2 SDHx; 17% grade->=3 CATECHOLAMINE-RELEASE SYNDROME - ICU pre-emption advised. NATALIE cabozantinib: ORR 25%, genotype-independent (Lancet Oncol 2024 - PMID 38608693; the ADJACENT-PMID pair with cabo-ACC 38608694) | PMID 41124218 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: FDA + NEJM + Lancet x2 + CVD literature (verified; the census headline)

refs.label: THE GERMLINE LAYER, verified: PPGL 30-40% hereditary ('all patients... should undergo clinical genetic testing' - verbatim; apparently-sporadic yield ~11-13%); SDHB = the malignancy driver (pooled malignancy 23% SDHB vs 3% SDHD - verbatim meta-analysis); ACC: TP53/Li-Fraumeni (the R337H receipt) verified; Lynch ~3% + MEN1 memory-grade; universal-testing convention guideline-grade

THE CORTISOL LAYER: hypercortisolism associates with worse ACC outcomes (verbatim: OS HR 2.28, DFS HR 2.42 - ASSOCIATION-grade, said); metyrapone+ketoconazole normalized UFC in 86% of ACC patients at 1 month (PMID 25624013, matched); osilodrostat = Cushing's-disease data EXTRAPOLATED to ACC (labeled off-label) | PMID 25624013 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

SURVIVAL ANCHORS (verified spreads, series-dependence said): ACC ENSAT 5-yr OS - stage I 66-82% / II 58-64% / III 24-50% / IV 0-17%; overall resected series 15-44% (the briefing's 35-50 at the optimistic edge - hedged); metastatic <15%. MALIGNANT PPGL 5-yr 34-74% (verbatim: 'half the patients have an indolent course with survival up to 20 years... the other half... 1-3 years' - the split clock)

CABOZANTINIB IN ACC - READ OUT (correction 58th-adjacent: no longer an open question): phase 2 POSITIVE (Lancet Oncol 2024 - PMID 38608694, matched: 72% [13/18] PFS>4mo, primary met; MD Anderson). THE ADJACENT-PMID TRAP: 38608693 = NATALIE (cabozantinib in PPGL, ORR 25%) - the registry's second adjacent-PMID pair (after pnet's 2011 twins). The successor: cabo+cemiplimab NCT06900595 = Alliance A092204 (randomized ph2; group-activated 2025-10-23) | PMID 38608694 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26
refs.src: Lancet Oncol x2 (matched; pair trap documented)

refs.label: THE GRAVEYARD: linsitinib GALACCTIC - the negative phase 3 (PMID 25795408, Lancet Oncol 2015, title-matched firsthand 2026-08-20; the cautionary precedent: ACC's one completed targeted phase 3 failed); VEGFR-MONO failed class (axitinib mPFS ~5.5 no confirmed responses; sorafenib+paclitaxel stopped for futility - secondhand); streptozocin = FIRM-ACT's inferior comparator; nivo+ipi weak-to-modest (no path). None carded (property); Azedra never carded (discontinued) | PMID 25795408 + abstract read firsthand 2026-08-26

THE CENSUS: cabo+cemiplimab (NCT06900595 = Alliance A092204, study chair Konda/OSU - RESOLVED: RANDOMIZED ph2 cabo +/- cemiplimab, PFS primary, ages >=12 [search-synthesis grade]; group-activated 2025-10-23, sites opening through early 2026 [DFCI 26-100, MSK 26-022, UCSD, Nebraska], RECRUITING 2026-08; the carried 2026-12 completion was NOT corroborated - dropped); ADCT-701 (NCT06041516 - anti-DLK1 ADC, NCI FIH, taking BOTH ACC and PPGL - the only adrenal ADC door, recruiting); 177Lu-PPGL (NCT03206060 - stage 2 ongoing; the MIBG-gap question); ADIUVO-2 (NCT03583710 - EU 18 sites; MD Anderson lists locally; US status CONFLICTING - never asserted); ACCOMPLISH pembro+lenva (NCT05036434 - US-door UNVERIFIED); relacorilant+pembro (NCT04373265 - COMPLETED, results unpublished - the watch). DESERTS verified: no FIRM-ACT successor; no US alpha-PPGL door (211At-MABG = Japan; AlphaMedix = GEP-NET); no ph3 PRRT-PPGL; no dedicated pediatric ACC protocol (IPACTR/Parana = registries); no US commercial MIBG; ONO-7475-PPGL = wrong premise (correction 58th)
